title: Pocketwire Personal Account Sending, Receiving and Balance Limits
content:
The payment limits of the Pocketwire Personal Account are set per plan. All figures are in USD.

| Plan | Weekly send limit (rolling 7 days) | Per-payment send limit | Rolling 30-day receive limit | Maximum ledger balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 299.99 | 299.99 | 999.99 | 1000.00 |
| Pocketwire Core | 7000.00 | 4999.99 | 50000.00 | 50000.00 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | 75000.00 | 100000.00 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 25000.00 | 10000.00 | 100000.00 | 150000.00 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 40000.00 | 15000.00 | 150000.00 | 250000.00 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 60000.00 | 25000.00 | 250000.00 | 250000.00 |

### Meaning of the limits

- **Weekly send limit** — the plan's default cap on the sum of P2P payments sent over the rolling 7-day window, which is today and the six preceding calendar days.
- **Per-payment send limit** — the largest single P2P payment that may be sent.
- **Rolling 30-day receive limit** — the cap on the sum of P2P payments received over the rolling 30-day window, which is today and the 29 preceding calendar days.
- **Maximum ledger balance** — the largest personal-account ledger balance the account may hold after any credit.

### Notes on the table

- On Pocketwire Lite the weekly send limit and the per-payment send limit are the same figure, 299.99.
- Pocketwire Onyx and Pocketwire Summit share the same maximum ledger balance of 250000.00, while their other limits differ.
